explanations.title: Builds a bounded, untrusted requirements prompt
explanations.summary: Adds a prompt section for between one and twenty requirements, rejecting duplicate or blank IDs, oversized text, and non-HTTPS provenance. It labels the issue content as untrusted and asks for changed-line evidence rather than conclusions based on similar wording.

explanations.title: Checks coverage claims against changed lines
explanations.summary: Requires exactly one result per requirement, with an allowed status and nonblank reason. Covered and partial results must cite changed lines; any supplied evidence must point to a changed line and include detail.

explanations.title: Renders coverage with an explicit limitation
explanations.summary: Renders requirement coverage as a sorted Markdown table with linked sources and evidence locations. The output clarifies that coverage is evidence from the diff, not proof the requirement is satisfied, and shows a fallback when no evidence is present.
